(#166397, #165355, #165417, #168161, #166517, #167651, #165775) Thanks @coolcoolwcr, @obviyus, @Tosko4, @noelff, @oshunter, @donquiche61, and @RomneyDa.

entries.original: **Provider-native compaction:** OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes now default to provider-native compaction, and compaction recovers when the primary auth profile is cooling down. (#168164, #166459) Thanks @obviyus and @hawkit.

entries.original: **Secret redaction:** credentials that cross a chunk boundary in long tool output are now masked, and redaction of large text no longer stalls or overflows the stack while running several times faster. (#161480, #166701, #167943) Thanks @eleqtrizit.

entries.original: **Prompt-cache stability:** Anthropic conversation checkpoints, enriched user prompts, tool results, and inter-session provenance stay byte-identical across follow-ups, replays, Gateway restarts, and subagent completions, so cached prefixes keep hitting. (#168042, #167938, #168392, #167898, #169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
